//: Generated and enforced. Run: npm run verify:app-compat
purpose: Records exactly which native-app material the companion carries, where it came from, and what the two sides agree about. compat/ is used by tests and is never served.
notes: Every file below is an EXACT byte copy of the native path at nativeSourceSha.
Exactness is deliberate: it makes staleness mechanically detectable instead of a judgement call.
If a copy ever has to be adapted, change its kind to "adapted", document the reason beside the code, and rely on the behavioural tests rather than the hash.
A local hash check cannot notice that native main has moved on. That is what the scheduled drift workflow is for.
